answer: Make each agent bond real collateral that peers can slash on misbehavior. A sybil swarm then looks like a hollow mesa: broad across the surface but with no staked history beneath it. To out-vote honest agents an attacker must fund thousands of deposits at once, and every slashed bond is a pearl surrendered to the pool. Votes scale linearly while forging a quorum scales in locked capital, so the swarm burns money faster than it can ever earn influence.
